aside.signupHeadline: People nearby are just one hello away.
aside.signupBubbleThem: Hi! I saw chess on your profile
aside.signupFootnote: Your email is only used to sign in and verify your account. It never appears on your profile.
aside.loginBubbleThem: You got 3 new messages while you were away
aside.resetBubbleThem: I think I forgot my password…

signup.title: Create account
signup.subtitle: Takes less than a minute.
signup.usernameHint: Letters, numbers and underscores. Shown on your profile.
signup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
signup.birthDateHint: Sohby is for people aged 18 and over. Your date of birth is never shown on your profile.
signup.genderHint: You can choose whether it appears on your profile in Settings.
signup.terms: I have read and accept the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and the <kvkk>Privacy notice (KVKK)</kvkk>.
signup.verifyNote: We'll send a verification link to your email to activate your account.
signup.successBody: We sent a verification link to {email}. Once you click it, you can start setting up your profile.
signup.successHint: If you can't find it, check your spam folder.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Pick up where you left off.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email linked to your account and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot.success: If an account exists for this address, a reset link will arrive in a few minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.noSession: Open this page from the reset link in your email. The link may have expired.

onboarding.previewTitle: Your profile will look like this
onboarding.previewBio: The part where you talk about yourself will appear here.

lookingFor.title: What are you looking for on Sohby?
lookingFor.subtitle: You can pick more than one. We use it to highlight people who suit you.
lookingFor.flirtNote: If you pick Dating, only people who picked it too will see it. People not looking for dating can't message you for that.

dating.title: Your dating preferences
dating.subtitle: This is only used to find matches and is never shown on your profile.
dating.interestLabel: Who would you like to meet?
dating.consentText: I give my explicit consent for Sohby to process my dating preference and the gender(s) I'm interested in, solely to show me suitable people. I can withdraw this consent at any time by removing the Dating option.

basics.title: How should we know you?
basics.subtitle: Your display name appears on your profile and in messages.
basics.birthDateHint: Sohby is for people aged 18 and over. Your date of birth is never shown and can't be changed later.

location.title: Where do you live?
location.subtitle: We use your city to find people nearby. We never ask for or share your exact location.
location.districtHint: Optional. You can choose whether it's shown in the last step.

hobbies.title: What do you enjoy?
hobbies.subtitle: Pick 1 to 15 hobbies. We'll highlight people who share them.

about.title: Tell us a bit about yourself
about.subtitle: A few lines are enough. You decide how much to share.
about.bioPlaceholder: Cinema on weekends, chess on weekdays. I love having coffee with new people.

privacy.title: What should your profile show?
privacy.subtitle: Anything you turn off is hidden from others. You can change these any time in Settings.
privacy.showInDiscoverHint: If off, only people you message can see you.
privacy.showDistrictHint: If off, only your city is shown.
privacy.showGenderHint: If off, your gender isn't shown on your profile.
privacy.showOnlineHint: Others can see when you're online.

policy.everyoneHint: Anyone on Sohby can message you directly.
policy.request_firstHint: First messages arrive as requests; the chat opens when you accept.
policy.common_hobby: Only people with a shared hobby
policy.common_hobbyHint: You must share at least one hobby; these also arrive as requests.

safety.blockBody: They won't be able to message you or send requests, and won't see you in Explore or on your profile. Your chat will be hidden for both of you. They won't be notified.
safety.reportIntro: Reports are confidential; {name} won't know who reported them.
safety.notePlaceholder: Briefly describe what happened. It helps our review.
safety.alsoBlockHint: They won't be able to message you or see you again.
safety.reportDone: Thank you. Our team will review it as soon as possible.
safety.reportDoneBlocked: Thank you. {name} has been blocked and our team will review your report as soon as possible.

errors.rate_limited: You've sent too many reports today. If it's an emergency, call 112.
errors.note_too_long: Notes can be at most 1000 characters.
errors.generic: Couldn't complete the action. Please try again.

landing.headline: Who are you chatting with tonight?
landing.subtitle: Meet people nearby who love the same things you do. Browse profiles and start with a hello.
landing.ageNote: Sohby is only for people aged 18 and over.

1.title: Join with your email
1.body: Pick a username and password, then verify your account with the link we email you.

2.title: Create your profile
2.body: Your neighbourhood, your hobbies, a few lines about you. You decide how much to share.

3.title: Message people you click with
3.body: Find people nearby or with shared hobbies, and send a message.

adult.title: 18+ only
adult.body: We ask for your date of birth at sign-up; under-18s can't register.

private.title: Private messages
private.body: Only the two people in a chat can see it.

safety.title: Block and report
safety.body: Keep anyone who bothers you away with one tap.

settings.title: Settings
settings.messagesHint: Tighten this if unexpected messages bother you.
settings.visibleHint: Anything you turn off is hidden from others.
settings.showInDiscoverHint: If off, only people you message can see you.
settings.showDistrictHint: If off, only your city is shown.
settings.showGenderHint: If off, your gender isn't shown on your profile.
settings.showOnlineHint: Others can see when you're online.
settings.showReadReceiptsHint: Others see when you've read their message. If off, you can't see theirs either.
settings.acceptAnonymousHint: Anonymous messages always arrive as requests; no chat opens until you accept.
settings.languageHint: Menus, notifications and emails use this language. Messages aren't translated.
settings.saveError: Couldn't save your settings. Please try again.
settings.blockedHint: If you unblock someone, they can message and see you again.
settings.deleteHint: Your account closes immediately and nobody can see you. Your messages are kept for 90 days for report reviews, then permanently deleted.
settings.deleteConfirmTitle: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
settings.deleteConfirmBody: This can't be undone. Your account closes immediately and you'll be signed out.
settings.deleteError: Couldn't delete the account. Please try again.
settings.flirtOnHint: Dating is on. Only mutual matches can see this. Your preference is never shown to anyone, and nobody (including you) can read it back.
settings.flirtOffHint: Dating is off. If you turn it on, only mutual matches will see it.
settings.flirtInterest: Who would you like to meet?
settings.flirtConsent: I give my explicit consent for my dating preference and the gender(s) I'm interested in to be processed solely to show me suitable people. I can withdraw this consent here at any time.
settings.flirtDisable: Turn off dating and withdraw consent
settings.flirtNeedInterest: Choose who you'd like to meet.
settings.flirtNeedConsent: You need to give explicit consent to use dating.
settings.flirtDisabled: Dating turned off; your preference was deleted.
